It’s been a lively summer at the New-York Historical Society.
New and exciting groups of Revolutionary War reenactors have been bringing history to life in the galleries and on the front steps for history enthusiasts of all ages every weekend!
Stop by before our Living History Weekends come to an end on Sunday, August 30.
While you’re here, don’t miss your chance to snap a photo with a few smartly-dressed 18th-century American patriots.
